Storage._comment_cloud: Set Provider=S3 + the fields below to enable the cloud tier (recommended target: Cloudflare R2 — ADR-009). For R2: Region='auto', ForcePathStyle=true, EndpointUrl=https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Credentials go in secrets (ADR-006), never here.

OrderPhotoArchive._comment: Intent 024 promote-on-paid lifecycle (bolt 051). MaxAttempts × Backoff sets the per-order retry envelope; the backoff schedule is indexed by Attempt-1 and clamps at the last value.

Archive._comment: Intent 024 retention lifecycle (bolt 052). PurgeOriginalAtStatus must be 'Shipped' or 'Delivered'. RetentionMonths is measured from Order.PaidAt — see ADR-012.

Vat._comment: Intent 016 bolt 038 — Romanian VAT. Rate is snapshotted onto Order.VatRate at creation; changing this value does NOT mutate existing orders (legal trail). Shipping is VAT-inclusive at the same rate as goods (Romanian B2C convention). Rounding is MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero per ADR-019.

Seller._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 — fiscal identity embedded in every UBL invoice and PDF. Validated at boot (SellerSettingsValidator). Single-tenant; per-request seller overrides are not supported.
Seller.Name: FotoTipar SRL

Anaf._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 — ANAF SPV e-Factura submission. Flip Enabled=true once OAuth credentials + PKCS#12 cert are provisioned. With Enabled=false the OAuth flow, HTTP client, and InvoiceUploadJob are never wired — production-identical to baseline. Secrets (ClientSecret, CertPath, CertPassword) via env vars only (Anaf__*). Retry budget 1h/4h/16h/64h then Failed, derived from CreatedAt per ADR-024.

Invoicing._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 dual-write rollout (ADR-022). Default Enabled=false suppresses customer-facing PDF email attachments while the full pipeline (XML, ANAF upload, PDF render, storage) runs. Flip to true after the production inspection week.

Sameday._comment: Intent 015 Sameday courier integration. Flip Enabled=true after credentials are provisioned in user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the static fallback IShippingService stays registered — see ADR-013/014. Credentials NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006).

Jobs._comment: Bolt 037 AWB + tracking lifecycle jobs. Orthogonal to Sameday:Enabled — keep Jobs:Enabled=false during initial rollout so credentials can be validated via the typed client before the workflow goes live. See ADR-015/016.

SecurityHeaders.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://js.stripe.com https://accounts.google.com; frame-src https://js.stripe.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.stripe.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

Sentry._comment: Intent 020 bolt 045 error tracking. Flip Enabled=true once Dsn is provisioned via user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the SDK is never constructed — production-identical to baseline. Dsn NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006). Release auto-derives from GIT_COMMIT_SHA env var (set by deploy workflow, bolt 040).

Observability._comment: Intent 020 bolt 044 OTel tracing + Prometheus metrics. Flip Enabled=true once an OTel collector + Prometheus are provisioned (DEPLOYMENT.md §14). With Enabled=false the SDK is never wired and /metrics is absent — production-identical to baseline. /metrics is gated by AllowedScrapeIps per ADR-018 (NOT by JWT). Sampling.Routes overrides per-route trace sample rate; deterministic by trace_id per ADR-017.
